values: Free Purchase Requisition Template: Excel + PDF
Blank is for your work. Filled example is fictional. Keep the original file.
Yellow cells are editable; gray cells calculate. Do not overwrite formulas.
Ten rows per form. Extra rows need formula and total-range checks; use another version instead.
Nonnegative numbers, at most two decimals. Quantity accepts three decimals. Invalid or partial rows block final amounts.
One currency code labels all amounts; no conversion. Browser JSON backups do not import into this workbook.
Save as a new .xlsx, reopen it, change one amount, and verify the total before operational use.
Select A1:H33 on the required form tab. Choose landscape, Print Selection, and fit one page. Check all text in print preview.
Built and round-trip tested with Artifact Tool. Native Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets have not been certified. Keep original formulas when converting.
Complete header and manual review fields yourself. Draft totals and typed status do not authorize a transaction.

Request 20 filters at $6 each and 5 pairs of gloves at $8, plus $10 shipping and $0 entered tax. The estimate is $120 + $40 + $10 = $170. Against an entered $160 budget, headroom is -$10. Reducing filters to 18 changes the estimate to $158 and headroom to $2; neither result approves the purchase.
Enter a unique request reference, requester, department, need-by date and business reason. A request should explain the work that will be delayed if the items are unavailable.
Use quantity and estimated price for the same unit. Twenty each at $6 is different from twenty boxes at $6. Add a suggested supplier and quote reference when known.
Enter shipping and tax as amounts in the selected currency. These are estimates you supply; the form does not look up supplier prices or tax rates.
Enter the budget available for this request. Negative headroom calls for a revised request or a budget decision. Positive headroom is only a cost comparison.
The reviewer enters a decision and fixed review date under your process. If the request proceeds, create the supplier PO separately and add its reference. Retain both versions.

Update the estimated price and quote reference before review, then save a version. If a supplier order already exists, handle the change through that purchasing process rather than replacing the historical request.
